variants.title: Kater's pendulum: T1 approximately equal to T2
variants.note: The weights have been slid until the two periods agree to a few parts in ten thousand; the second term of Bessel's formula is then almost nothing.

source.title: Generic apparatus: the value is a setting of this bench, not a property of a named material

variants.title: Kater's pendulum: T1 not equal to T2
variants.sample: Brass Kater's pendulum, weights not adjusted
variants.note: The two periods differ by about 2 %. Bessel's formula still gives g, but now h1 − h2 must be known well.

source.title: Generic apparatus: the value is a setting of this bench, not a property of a named material
